authority.approval: Greg, 2026-10-08T17:44:35Z: As is tradition. 😎 we march
authority.scope: Three explicit release findings, preserved held delivery, complete refrozen evaluation and revised delivery

immutable: all prior protocols, freezes, evidence and held/failed deliverables

batches.work: Hash this supplement before implementation; verify committed archive identities and local raw hashes; inventory native comparisons and parent worlds before generating replacements. Preserve unresolved materialization/save failures.
batches.gate: Prospective protocol committed; actual recoverable inventory with hashes, missing members and blockers recorded.

batches.work: Repair forged-completion negative-control harness and add accepting-auditor regression.
batches.gate: Exactly one latest cancelled history-same-recurrence native child status is changed to succeeded in copied transactions from IEE04; retained paid first step, absent genuine consumer and unchanged access asserted. Ordinary longitudinal audit must actually reject; acceptance raises test failure. Preserve mutated raw evidence and audit reason.
batches.claim: Rejection of unpaid forged completion; not evidence of rejection of a fully paid interruption-bypass recurrent arm. Inspect protocol and ordinary semantics before credit. If fully paid bypass is required, prospectively evaluate an evaluator-only real bypass plus paid terminal consumer and independent rejection; no inherited contract reinterpretation.

batches.work: Export and independently reconstruct required native continuation and negative worlds.
batches.gate: 192 unique keys = 32 cells x canonical/workflow x three boundaries. Canonical C2 24 from indices 0,1,3; C3 72; workflow 96. No cancelled-encounter/new-request substitutions. Each key contains hashed boundary, original-terminal and restored-terminal raw refs, exact initial restore, exact terminal equality, paid progression and semantic evidence plus independent ordinary audits. Cancellation, exhaustion and stale dependency evidence in each setting.

batches.work: Complete distinct canonical parent scenarios using inherited C4 group-change and real-withdrawal method; reuse verified existing worlds when available.
batches.gate: Eight raw scenario/setting keys: ordinary, cancelled-child, membership-change, withdrawal across canonical/workflow. Four workflow worlds, canonical normal and cancelled-child preserved; two distinct missing canonical worlds exported only if inventory confirms absence. Ablation/context cases do not substitute; cancelled-child semantics unchanged.

batches.work: Prepare revised raw-based joint ledger builder/verifier and complete evaluation orchestration before release freeze.
batches.gate: Independent assessment reads actual raw semantics, all applicable per-cell gates, corrected negative controls and exact inventories. Never promote historical flags or test counts alone. Split prospectively if scope exceeds capacity.

batches.work: New complete release source freeze and full FB6.2 rerun.
batches.gate: All exact 732 inherited/accepted method IDs plus exact new IDs; all original 47 mandatory jobs/panels and raw independent verifiers plus corrective panels; 81 isolated cost workers with unchanged 3x/2x thresholds; probes 10/10 and 17/17 on intake-identical kernel; all executed-file hashes unchanged. Full refreeze/rerun after any evaluation-source change. Failed/source-changed attempts retained.

batches.work: Independent final ledger assessment and clean-unpack revised durable delivery.
batches.gate: Revised decision from raw verified cells, clean-unpack source/evidence manifests, inspector and reproduce checks. Store large immutable archives in Library; source/index/summary checkpoints in GitHub. Bounded resumable stages. Preserve old held decision and partial delivery; no completion if any gate remains unsupported.

stop_rules: All original repeated-failure-after-correction, theory-contradiction, inherited-contract and author-ruling stops remain. No baseline changes, no Phase 7. Stop on denied approval; do not route around it.
coordination: Expected-head lease protection; defer to any active owner. No scheduler changes. User reports resumed schedule, independently unverified.
freeze_policy: Each implementation batch freezes before its counted evaluation. Exploratory checks are explicitly uncredited. Final source freeze after all evaluation implementation; full mandatory rerun.
evidence_policy: Hashes checked on exact local bytes. Missing archive/member is missing evidence, never regenerated as historical evidence. New exports are labelled prospective. Immutable historical archives remain in Library.
